title: See You Again

cues.en: It's been a long day without you my friend and I'll tell you all about it when I see you again we've come a long way from where we began
cues.zh: 沒有你的日子真是漫長，我的朋友，當我再次見到你時，我會告訴你這一切，我們已經從我們開始的地方走了很長一段路

cues.en: I know we love to hit the road and laugh but something told me that it wouldn't last had to switch up

cues.en: Look at things different, see the bigger picture, those were the days hard work forever pays
cues.zh: 看待事物不同，看到更大的前景，那些是努力工作永遠得到回報的日子

cues.en: Now I see you in a better place, see you in a better place
